subject: Real-world data for perception models
text:
Hi [NAME],

Seems like the perception/autonomy team is growting at [COMPANY], similar to
when our agtech customers (Carbon Robotics, Aigen, and Four Growers) were
scaling up their labelling operations. I'd love to connect and see if some
of the challenges they faced might resonate with you.

For context, Physical AI teams typically come to Encord as their real-world
data volume increases. We help by automating annotations for object
detection and semantic/instance segmentation, as well as integrating
labelling pipelines with dataset curation and label QA capabilities. All
with the goal of accelerating model iteration cycles and increasing
labeling throughput.

How are you currently approaching scalable training data pipelines? We're
flexible morning times MT if you're open to exchanging insights.

subject: In the Loop: Human Data Roundtable - Sept 10 SF
text:
Hi [NAME],

Came across your recent feature on the People of Data Podcast - our
President [SENDER] is actually co-hosting a roundtable on the same
topic with our partner Prolific!  Appreciate travels might be a blocker,
thought I'd extend an invite regardless in case you're in SF for those
dates.

guests and experts joining from leading AI labs and companies including
Anthropic, Glean, Descript, etc.

Human expertise is at the heart of effective AI. That's why Encord and

today.

We're keeping to max 20 people - so let me know if you can make it!

subject: Chris - is your team trying to scale video annotations?
text:
Hey [NAME],

Great to see you were checking out Encord - wondering if there was anything
I could help with?

Very excited to see that [SENDER] Koberg and the team are working on AI-driven
content summaries / annotations - so was curious to understand more about
how you plan to scale this across the library of sports events.

For context, Encord works closely with many of the leading Sports Analytics
AI teams including Hudl, GameChanger, Veo, Genius Sports, SwingVision -
helping them to scale their video annotation / curation pipelines, so
curious to explore if we can help in a similar way at PlayOn?

Let me know if you'd like to find a time to chat early next week, Monday
and Tuesday AM ET both quite open for me atm,

subject: [Invite] London AI Data Leaders Dinner - 23/09
text:
Hi [NAME],

Our CEO, [SENDER] is hosting an intimate roundtable dinner for AI & Data Leaders in London and we'd love for you to join us, if you're available.

We've reserved a private dining room for ~20 guests at the Coal Office, Kings Cross on Tuesday 23rd September, starting at 6:30 PM. Confirmed attendees include CxOs and senior technical leaders from Synthesia, DeepMind, and Cohere.

It'll be an informal, open-format evening - no slides or pitches, just bringing together like-minded people to discuss their experiences & challenges working with AI data.

Would you be interested in joining / available on the 23rd?
